Name: Sophia With New Winter Costum for Cuter Seasonal Outfits
Author: SunkWood
Description:
I love this cute and fluffy hat so much! So I decided to edit the winter sprites and portraits from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE[/url] into this new costum that [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url] added.
 
[size=3][b]Details :[/b][/size]
Edit sprites based on origenal sprites created  by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/46021252]FlashShifter[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister[/url] (winter indoor and winter outdoor).
Redraw [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister[/url]'s slightly cuter Sophia portrais based on her [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url] new outfit (winter indoor and winter outdoor).
Edit [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/54606682]nyapu[/url]'s Sophia portrais based on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu's Portraits(SVE)[/url] (winter indoor only).
I didn't change her top cus redrawing it is too difficult to me :(

[b][size=3]Install:﻿
[/size][/b]> Install both [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE[/url]
> Download and unzip this mod
> Replace file

[b][size=3]Credit:
[/size][/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/46021252]FlashShifter[/url] for outfit design and sprites from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister[/url] for sprites and portrais from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/54606682]nyapu[/url] for portrais from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu's Portraits inspired by Dong

[/url] Thank you for these bueatiful arts and open permissions!
